messages:
caro (PM): short sync: we need a buyer-facing checklist for routing + multi-region + tenant isolation. sales wants something they can point to in scoping calls.
derek (Arch): agree. propose we move away from 'lanes' language and publish 3 contract profiles: locked-region, regional-resilient, and pooled-economy. each profile should include placement model, SLO envelope, and rollback semantics.
yuan (Infra): implementation realities: locked-region requires enforced placement in scheduler + egress gates; regional-resilient needs warm standby + traffic-drain tooling; pooled-economy needs aggressive batching and quantization support. reserved capacity will be required for locked-region pilots.
rachel (Sales): customers ask for 3 things: 1) contract p95 commitments, 2) a residency addendum they can sign, 3) a preview UI that shows cost vs latency for each profile. HealthCo and LedgerBank are interested in pilots.
legal-bot: reminder: include clause RES-LOCK-1 for any locked-region pilot agreements.
caro (PM): minimal GA checklist draft (concise): A) residency enforcement automated tests green, B) end-to-end SLO validation for each profile, C) two pilot cutovers with 14d stability, D) billing reconciliation within 5%, E) migration runbook + rollback steps.
derek (Arch): suggested SLOs (initial): locked-region p95 <= 200ms (in-region), regional-resilient p95 <= 180ms including failover window, pooled-economy p95 <= 320ms but target 35-50% token cost reduction vs resilient. GA availability >= 99.95% for paid contracts.
yuan (Infra): tests we need: multi-region replay, tenant isolation fuzzing (noisy neighbor emulation), cutover shadowing, and billing-tag reconciliation. ETA: locked-region infra + audit sink ~4 sprints, resilient plumbing ~2 sprints, pooled cost tuning ~3 sprints.
rachel (Sales): pilot ask: can we offer a 60-day pilot with migration support and a runbook? customers will want a shadow run for 7-14 days before cutover. also need a one-page sales brief for each profile.
derek (Arch): product knobs: expose profile in Console + API. sketch policy fields: profile=locked|resilient|pooled, region_pin=<region|null>, failover=auto|manual. store derived routing keys in tenant metadata to avoid per-request JSON parse.
yuan (Infra): ops note: add an audit trail for routing decisions and for any manual overrides. overrides must require an approver and be time-limited. also plan a small reserved SKU for locked-region pilots and a capacity worksheet.
legal-bot: task created: residency addendum draft -> @legal (due Mon).
caro (PM): prioritization: 1) residency enforcement + audit logs, 2) Console policy editor + profile preview, 3) reserved SKU + pricing model, 4) pooled profile cost optimizations. we gate GA on the checklist above.
rachel (Sales): i'll source two anchor pilots (HealthCo, LedgerBank) if we commit to the timeline. need the pilot pack and legal contact.
derek (Arch): migration pattern: mirror/shadow traffic for 7-14d, limited percent traffic cutover for 48-72h, then DNS flip with rollback window. record metrics: latency delta, error budget burn, and cost delta. gate GA on two pilots with stable metrics for 14d post-cutover.
yuan (Infra): will prototype placement enforcement and post routing audit sink; posting ETA tomorrow.
caro (PM): action items: derek -> architecture spec + acceptance tests (EOW). yuan -> reserved SKU worksheet + infra ETA (Tue). rachel -> lock two pilots + legal contacts (Mon). i'll draft pilot pack and GA checklist.
